title: **Tighten first, drop story last.**
text: Meet the length by tightening before dropping any story passage; drop a passage only when the tightened cut is still long, and say what fact it loses. On 20261126 the agent dropped 7 passages (3.6 min) for the 20-min line; the user kept three of them (the ธรรมนัส clause, คุณกิ๊ก's own donation, the face-scan case) and made the time from 360 s of pauses and filler. Confirmed by the user 2026-11-26 ("Yes, confirm both").

source.heading: Diff against the user's D1 (2026-11-26, after the D1 export)

confirm: How many seconds did tightening take out, and which story passages were still dropped for length (source timecodes, the fact each loses)?
probe: Length came from tightening, not from dropping story
